reason: The cited evidence shows oxygen-induced chemical clustering and a spinodal limit in NbTiZr (E3), but does not demonstrate that this decomposition enhances oxidation resistance or material integrity; it only speculates about potential benefits. The claim of improved properties is unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Oxygen induces spinodal decomposition in RMPEAs
Spinodal decomposition leads to phase separation and nanoscale complex formation
Resulting oxide-dispersion-strengthened microstructure enhances oxidation resistance and material integrity
This mechanism operates in equimolar NbTiZr and similar RMPEAs at 700–1250°C
The process improves hardness and strength relative to unoxidized single-phase alloy
